snippet.title: Netherwake | DEMO IS OUT Gameplay 2 #horror #horrorgame #indiegame #indiehorror
snippet.description:
Wishlist NETHERWAKE on Steam today:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3652920/Netherwake/

PLAY THE NETHERWAKE DEMO NOW:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4592210/Netherwake_Demo/

Nalycan are the developers behind games like Light of Veilendor, The Mare, and the upcoming Netherwake.

Step into the forest of Netherwake where the cold never leaves and the silence feels alive. Flickering streetlights barely cut through the thick fog, rain seeps into the ground beneath your feet, and something unseen lingers in the darkness. This is not just a place… it’s a presence.


Check out other videos from NALYCAN to see what’s coming next in the world of indie horror:
https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLMNvfmrNUZkBb5r6QN-BjbBQ_znbi97Kj&si=Y-lE-ohG7v7A1Xmp
